summary: Iteration 4 validates the bulk_connect.py login-input resilience fix. All 19 new tests + all 33 iteration_3 regression tests pass (52/52). Protected files (publisher.py, publisher_queue.py, browser_session.py) verified unchanged via git diff. Static + monkey-patched-mock verification confirms: selector order exact, wait_until='load' replaces 'domcontentloaded', document.readyState==='complete' wait present, LoginInputNotFound(RuntimeError) with .artifacts replaces raw TimeoutError, BULK_DEBUG_DIR created at import time, graceful failure path sets state.status='failed' cleanly, password/submit locators untouched, popup/OTP constants untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix implementation is clean and scope-respecting. Only bulk_connect.py modified (+163/-5 lines).
Diagnostic artifacts written to backend/logs/bulk_connect_debug/ include url, title, html, screenshot — sufficient for future RCA if IG changes selectors again.
Fallback ordering aria-label -> autocomplete -> name -> type='text' is sensible; the type='text' fallback is broad but appropriate as the last resort on a login page.
Consider (future improvement, not required now): treat 'input[type="text"]' match as a warning log since it's the most ambiguous fallback.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_4 confirms bulk_connect.py login-input fix. Test file at backend/tests/test_bulk_connect_login_fix.py provides both static invariants and monkey-patched mock Playwright objects (FakePage/FakeLocator) that can be reused for future login-flow changes. Real Playwright/IG cannot be tested in this sandbox — only static + mock verification is feasible. The FakePage stub supports goto/wait_for_function/locator/title/content/screenshot.
rca of the issue: Original TimeoutError arose because page.goto used wait_until='domcontentloaded', which fires before IG's React bundle mounts <input name='username'>. Fix: switch to wait_until='load', explicitly wait for document.readyState==='complete', then poll a 4-selector fallback list (aria-label, autocomplete, name, type='text') until one is visible. On timeout, dump URL/title/HTML/screenshot to backend/logs/bulk_connect_debug/ and raise a descriptive LoginInputNotFound instead of a raw TimeoutError, which is caught by _connect_one_account to set state.status='failed' cleanly.
